scenarios.name: worker_loss
scenarios.limit: No worker process was killed and no Temporal server was started. Resume is replay of constructed history, which does not call the tool or model.

scenarios.name: tool_model_outage
scenarios.limit: The outage is the in-process fixture. No OpenRouter call and no MCP process were started.

scenarios.name: bad_rollout
scenarios.limit: Rollback rewrites the staging pin file. It does not reverse a migration, unsend a model call, or change a live cluster.

scenarios.name: database_outage
scenarios.limit: The outage disables login for the disposable test role and terminates its sessions. The retained product database was not stopped.

scenarios.name: quota_exhaustion
scenarios.limit: The cap is the in-process tenant workload limit of one. It is not a distributed quota and it does not change small-v1.
